conceptZh: 「羊」變成毛線圍巾架，小玩具羊拉下短短的圍巾，竟捲出比自己大好幾倍的毛線球。
object: A solid teal 羊 sculpture, a wool scarf, and a tiny wind-up toy sheep
morph: The glyph remains structurally unchanged while a scarf unwinds from its lowest horizontal stroke into an absurdly oversized yarn ball.
creativeAngle: 把完整字形當成圍巾架，利用短圍巾竟拉出巨大毛線球的尺寸反差製造笑點；不靠羊角或臉部變形，確保六筆清楚。
promptEn: Create an exactly 8-second animated toy comedy in a softly lit peach studio, with a locked frontal camera. Center one correctly formed Traditional Chinese glyph 羊, built as a flat-faced, saturated teal toy sculpture occupying approximately 70% of frame height with generous margins. Use standard textbook glyph proportions: two distinct upper marks, three separate horizontal strokes, and one central vertical stroke. Keep its silhouette rigid and its strokes clearly distinguishable throughout. A cream wool scarf hangs over the lowest horizontal stroke without concealing its outline; its folded length is tucked behind that bar. A tiny wind-up toy sheep stands beside the scarf's dangling end. From 0.0–1.4 seconds, the sheep takes the end in its mouth and gives a small tug, then pauses expectantly. From 1.4–3.5 seconds, the surprisingly long scarf unravels into yarn that the sheep enthusiastically winds with a little mechanical tail spindle. The ball grows to three times the sheep's height; the sheep stops winding and slowly looks up at its ridiculous achievement. From 3.5–4.6 seconds, one gentle nudge sends the lightweight ball rolling out to the right, with the sheep trotting after it. Keep this action beside the centered glyph and fully within the frame until the deliberate exit. From 4.6–8.0 seconds, hold the completely bare 羊 motionless and unobstructed, preserving its full height and margins. Use tactile felt and painted wood textures, bright restrained colors, soft shadows, and gentle comic movement. Audio: a warm, friendly off-screen voice speaks clear Taiwanese Mandarin, saying exactly 「羊、羊、綿羊」: the first 羊 around 0.5 seconds, the second around 2.0 seconds, and 綿羊 around 5.3 seconds during the clear final hold. Leave natural pauses and stop after the word. Add only quiet wool-rustling and toy-winding sounds beneath the voice. The single 羊 is the only on-screen text; keep the vocabulary audio-only, with no subtitles, other lettering, watermark, clutter, or flashing effects.

conceptZh: 兔子魔術師輕敲「羊」的三條橫畫施法，帽子卻冒出一隻蓬鬆綿羊，把正在偷看的兔子頂成仰躺姿勢。
object: A rigid teal 羊 sculpture, an original cartoon magician rabbit with a top hat, and one round cartoon sheep.
morph: The glyph remains correctly formed and stationary; tapping its three horizontal strokes summons a sheep whose expanding fleece gently tips the rabbit backward.
creativeAngle: 把三條橫畫當成施法的觸點，改用魔術帽冒出過度蓬鬆綿羊的失誤笑點；字形全程固定，不再使用圍巾或毛線球，也不讓羊毛遮住筆畫。
promptEn:
Create an exactly 8-second animated comedy with tactile felt characters and a locked frontal camera in a bright, softly lit pale-apricot studio. Center one solid saturated-teal Traditional Chinese glyph 羊, occupying about 70% of frame height with comfortable margins. Use a standard textbook form: two separate inward-slanting upper marks, three distinct horizontal strokes, and a central vertical stroke crossing all three horizontals and extending below the lowest. Preserve this rigid, readable silhouette throughout.

The lead is an original, theatrically confident cartoon magician rabbit with floppy ears and a plum top hat. Its only supporting character is one round cream-colored cartoon sheep. Stage their action beside the glyph in the generous right-hand space of a wide composition, with every character fully framed.

At 0.0–1.3 seconds, the rabbit removes its hat, sets it opening-up beside the glyph, and confidently taps the right endpoint of each of the three horizontal strokes in descending order. Its small paw briefly touches only the endpoints. At 1.3–2.4 seconds, nothing happens. The rabbit straightens proudly, notices the empty hat, then bends close to inspect it. At 2.4–3.6 seconds, a tiny sheep head peeks out; its unexpectedly enormous, soft spherical fleece rises underneath the rabbit's chin and gently rolls the rabbit backward onto the wool, paws pointing upward. The sheep gives one quiet bleat while the rabbit blinks in baffled surprise. Keep the entire fleece to the right of the glyph. At 3.6–4.7 seconds, the sheep steps free of the hat and its fleece settles to a compact round shape, lowering the rabbit gently onto its feet. The rabbit retrieves its hat and gives a sheepish little bow beside its successful creation.

From 4.7–8.0 seconds, hold the centered, fully unobstructed 羊 completely still; the rabbit and sheep remain quietly posed beside it. No camera movement or new action during this final hold.

Audio: a warm, friendly off-screen voice speaks clear Taiwanese Mandarin, saying exactly 「羊、羊、綿羊」. Place the first 羊 around 0.4 seconds, the second around 1.7 seconds, and 綿羊 around 5.4 seconds while the finished glyph remains clearly visible. Stop after the word. Use only soft tapping, felt rustling, and the quiet bleat beneath the voice, without music. The single 羊 is the only visible text; the vocabulary is audio only. No subtitles, logos, watermark, clutter, or flashing effects.
